observations: B (a coffee cup, no pet): the detector returned one box (cat, score 0.495, above the 0.40 operating point) and the classifier returned dog with confidence 1.000 on that crop; the photo was referred (disagreement, segmentation_unmatched, animal_too_small). One out-of-scope example, not a false-positive rate; classifier confidence is not meaningful on non-pet crops.
D (blank image): no_animal referral; the API still fills species/confidence from the whole frame and the page does not display them.
C (same photo twice): two detections, multiple_animals referral. Synthetic; does not change the historical 17/52 multi-animal result on real photos.
